messages:
marco: Grafana alert fired: token-p99-ttft > 1200ms in eu-west-2 for the last 5m. Seeing matching spike on the TTFT heatmap and a dip in tokens/sec. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/token-slo-heatmap?orgId=1
anya: oncall here, pulling the panels now. Do we have the prom query for the p99 we can paste?
liam: pasted the alert expr in the alert def: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference",region="eu-west-2"}[5m])) by (le))
```
liam: tokens/sec query I run: 
```
sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total{job="inference",region="eu-west-2"}[1m]))
```
anya: quick look — kvcache_evictions_total{region="eu-west-2"} spikes right at 2049123400-2049123450, +8k evictions in 2m.
jess: interesting, pod restarts in the west2 shard around the same time: `kubectl -n inference get pods | grep west2` shows 3 restarts on shard-pod-17. Logs show OOM kill on kvcache-worker: 
```
[2024-11-15T10:10:34Z] kvcache-worker[pid=178]: eviction: reclaim 120MB, reason=OOM
[2024-11-15T10:10:36Z] kvcache-worker[pid=178]: restarted
```
marco: could be a config tweak we rolled last hour (kvcache.default_max_entries=200k -> 120k). @anya did we roll that?
anya: yes that change went via infra-pr #4127 at ~2049120000. I reverted it to 200k on west2 and restarted kvcache-daemon. Rolling back across other regions now.
ops-bot: Deploy rollback triggered: infra-pr-4127 rollback started by anya. CI: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/7823
liam: after revert, tokens/sec recovered to baseline within ~40s and p99 dropped below 600ms on the last 3m sample.
jess: double-checking provisioning — we also had a brief scheduling delay for GPU pool in west2; scheduler logs show `insufficient capacity` for 30s while autoscaler tried to spin new pods.
marco: quick mitigation: bumped dedicated west2 pool from 4 -> 6 GPUs to reduce queueing and cold-starts: 
```
rctl pools scale --name=dedicated-west2 --replicas=6 --reason="p99 surge mitigation"
```
marco: alerting note: current Grafana alert fires on 5m histogram quantile, maybe too sensitive to short kvcache blips. Propose to change p99 alert to 10m window and add a tokens/sec vs p99 ratio alert.
jess: suggested alert expr for ratio: 
```
(p99_query) / (sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[5m])) > 0)
```
liam: cost note: if this kept up we'd be ~€2.3k/day in additional GPU hours due to autoscaler churn and failed requests. We'll add a cost tag to the incident.
srebot: Incident INC-2024-178 created (priority=P2). Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2024-178
anya: follow-ups: 1) revert risky kvcache tuning in infra PRs 2) add kvcache_evictions -> page alert 3) tune p99 alert to 10m 4) postmortem if recurrence.
marco: sounds good. I'll keep monitoring for 30m and then clear the alert if stable. Thanks all :thumbsup:
